# OSGi Utils

> A Java utility library that simplifies common OSGi tasks — bundle lifecycle tracking, configuration change monitoring, ranked service caching, bundle utilities, and reflection-based mock testing without a running container.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (compile) / Java 17 (runtime target), OSGi Core 6.0 / Compendium 6.0
- Maven multi-module project, 6 modules (3 code + 3 packaging)
- OSGi Declarative Services, Google Guava 30, Lombok, Apache Karaf 4.4.7
- Build with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw clean install`)
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams and build instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with module details, build commands, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines

## Modules — Core

- [osgi-api/pom.xml](osgi-api/pom.xml): Public API — interfaces (BundleTrackerManager, ConfigurationTrackerManager), utilities (BundleUtil, PropertiesUtil), service caches (ServiceCache, ServiceCacheByProperty), and data types
- [osgi-impl/pom.xml](osgi-impl/pom.xml): OSGi DS component implementations — BundleTrackerManagerImpl (synchronous bundle listener), ConfigurationTrackerManagerImpl (synchronous configuration listener), OsgiUtil
- [osgi-test/pom.xml](osgi-test/pom.xml): MockOsgi testing utility — activates/deactivates components and binds/unbinds @Reference dependencies via reflection without a running OSGi container

## Modules — Packaging

- [features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor bundling osgi-api, osgi-impl with guava-30 and scr dependencies
- [kar/pom.xml](kar/pom.xml): Karaf KAR archive assembly for deployment
- [reports/pom.xml](reports/pom.xml): JaCoCo aggregate code coverage reports

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
